brief: 81BPM intimate postmodern lo-fi; dry crooked broken beat, muted analog bass, slow low-mid synth and organ fragments. No bells, chimes, mallets, glassy pings, metallic melodic tails, piano or plucked lead, including intro and ending. Understated drama, no epic climax or voices.
acceptance: Decoded and measured; artistic acceptance and exact absence of bell-like timbres require listening. This is a new composition, not stem removal from an earlier recording. Earlier universal tracks remain on disk and in the listening library. Regional Asian calm tracks are unchanged.
